title: V11 Per-Task Review Config
description: Optional per-project knob at sessions/{project}/.review-config.json (V11.15). Controls the post-task adversarial-lite review loop. Absent file = all defaults = review every completed task (user-decided default).

enabled.description: Master switch. false = orchestrator skips the post-task review step entirely.

scope.description: all = every completed task (default). risk-gated = only risk in {medium,high} OR complexity in {complex,novel}. sampled = every sample_rate-th task + always complex/novel.

sample_rate.description: Used only when scope=sampled: review 1 of every N routine tasks. 1 = review all.

min_difficulty_to_review.description: Reserved: skip recording reviews whose difficulty is below this (1 = record all).

severity_autofix.description: Severities the orchestrator may auto-dispatch adversarial-lite-fixer for (A3+ autonomy gated). CRITICAL is never auto-fixable by contract.

severity_escalate.description: Severities that create a blocker task + escalate to orchestrator instead of auto-fixing.
